attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter. He is not quoting anyone else here.

semantics.note: The proposition keeps his exact wording, including the 'it seems' hedge. It is a qualified observation about rising costs, with no threshold or period given.

contract.note: The contract rightly treats 'it seems' as an epistemic hedge and does not swap in a firm spending claim from the surrounding figures. 'Dramatically' has no threshold, so no fair support or contradiction test can be set.

reviews.rationale: This is a hedged impression ('it seems', 'cursory glance') with no stated metric, period or threshold. Under policy, hedged language is not scored. The packet also has no outcome evidence: the only source is the article itself, used only for wording.
